messages:
deploy-bot: Release candidate v2.14.0 -> canary: BLOCKED by compliance gates
deploy-bot: reason: SBOM missing PURL for component 'fastcache' (3 occurrences); vuln-scan flagged transitive license risk (GPL-3.0, HIGH) for package 'libcompress' (transitive)
deploy-bot: logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/1843/artifacts/sbom.json

jess (eng-release): looking into SBOM now. can you paste the failing lines from the scan?

sam (security): pls include the vuln id / scan rule. if it's only transitive license we sometimes allow with mitigation plan.

mohit (infra): quick idea — we could pin the base image digest and run an internal-only canary to limit blast radius. change window after midnight UTC?

lee (product): internal-only canary sounds OK if customers aren't impacted. what duration? 2h?

riley (legal): legal needs the SBOM + provenance for the component authorship. if there's GPL transitive exposure we need the mitigation documented. quarantine until we have that.

jess (eng-release): paste from sbom.json: ```
  "components": [
    {"name": "fastcache", "version":"1.3.2", "purl": ""},
    {"name": "libcompress", "version":"0.9.7", "purl": "pkg:npm/libcompress@0.9.7"}
  ]
```
fastcache has empty purl, and libcompress shows license: "GPL-3.0" via dependency chain (transitive).

sam (security): thanks. If we can add purl for fastcache and show it's MIT on package page, we can clear. For libcompress, need root cause: is it shipped, or only built-time? If not distributed, lower risk. I can approve a limited canary if legal signs off.

riley (legal): I can sign off for internal-only canary if engineering adds a brief mitigation plan to the release notes and we keep rollout to <5% traffic. Need SBOM + proof PURL added.

jess (eng-release): proposal: 1) add purl to SBOM and push artifact (will do now), 2) pin base image digest to sha256:abc123..., 3) start internal-only canary at 02:00 UTC for 2h, 4) require manual ack from @sam and @riley before expanding to public. Rollback plan: automatic rollback to v2.13.9 if error rate >1% or if manual abort.

mohit (infra): I can pin image and set canary flag in deploy config. snippet:
```
canary:
  scope: internal
  percent: 3
  window: 2h
image: gcr/redwood/service@sha256:abc123def456
```

deploy-bot: AWAITING approvals: security, legal

sam (security): ack pending purl update. will re-run scan once SBOM is updated.

riley (legal): ack conditional on release note mitigation paragraph. riley will sign in the audit log.

jess (eng-release): updating SBOM now and pushing new artifact link: https://ci.redwood/internal/1843/artifacts/sbom-updated.json

deploy-bot: compliance check: SBOM purl present for fastcache; vulnerability scan re-run queued (job 1843-2). status: queued

sam (security): re-scan result: libcompress flagged but tagged as build-time-only per provenance. security approves internal-only canary. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Can deploy to internal canary at 02:00 UTC. waiting for manual trigger from jess

jess (eng-release): triggering deploy now. starting internal canary.

deploy-bot: Canary started (3% internal orgs). monitoring.

lee (product): will monitor metrics dashboard and flag any regression.

riley (legal): added mitigation to release notes: "Mitigation: internal canary, provenance verified, legal approval on file." logged.

deploy-bot: CANARY_RUNNING -> no regressions after 1h. manual approvals present. security & legal approve expansion after change window at 04:00 UTC.

jess (eng-release): plan to expand to full public rollout at 04:00 UTC unless anyone objects before 03:50.

sam (security): no objections from security.

riley (legal): no objections from legal.

deploy-bot: Can expand to public rollout at 04:00 UTC per change window. release note link: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.14.0-notes

jess (eng-release): closing thread. thanks everyone :rocket:
